# Daily Briefing – Friday 9 October

Yesterday was a lighter day — no training session and just 5,657 steps, though your body still burned 2,331 kcal, sitting neatly above your 2,300 target. Not every day needs to be a big effort day, and sometimes that's exactly right.

Your recovery markers look genuinely solid. HRV at 100ms sits right at the floor of your baseline range, resting HR a very healthy 47bpm, and stress at just 28/100 — your body is calm and responded well to the rest. No reason to hold back today; go ahead as planned with confidence.

Sleep at 6.7 hours is the one thing worth nudging. Even 30 extra minutes tonight would sharpen tomorrow's performance noticeably. Hit your 175g protein today — after a rest day your muscles are primed to use it well. You're in a good place, keep building.
